description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Classical Conversations is seeking a Junior Software Developer to support web-based applications used by its affiliated companies and homeschool communities. The role involves structured training, feature development, testing, paired programming, problem-solving, documentation, code reviews, and ongoing professional development.
Entry-level application developer building features, testing code, troubleshooting issues, and maintaining technical documentation

Responsibilities:
• Complete structured training in company systems and development practices, building your skills methodically over your first year
• Contribute to feature solutions according to design specifications, delivering assigned work on schedule and to standard
• Perform unit-level and feature-level testing by established standards, maintaining high-quality code with minimal defects
• Participate in paired programming with mid-level and senior developers, absorbing best practices through consistent, hands-on mentorship
• Analyze and resolve technical and application problems methodically, working through issues with patience and attention to detail
• Document code changes and maintain technical documentation, ensuring accuracy and consistency the team can rely on
• Participate in code reviews and provide thoughtful, well-considered feedback to strengthen the team's overall code quality
• Complete assigned training modules and certifications within established timelines, steadily building toward mastery

Requirements:
• To succeed in this job, an individual must satisfactorily perform all essential duties. The requirements below represent the necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities. Reasonable accommodations may be provided for individuals with disabilities
• Associate's Degree in a Computer Science-related field
• or equivalent relevant work experience
• No prior software development experience required
• Basic knowledge of unit testing theory and Test-Driven Development principles
• Basic knowledge of software development, including application of the Software Development Lifecycle
• Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint)
• Strong analytical skills
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to follow design specifications, test plans, and directions in building applications
• Ability to sit at a computer workstation for extended periods (up to 8 hours daily)
• Color vision is required for reviewing charts, graphs, and visual presentations
• Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds occasionally

Preferred:
• Bachelor's preferred
• 1 year preferred
• Basic exposure to web development using HTML, PHP, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, and C# desired
